No email is printed for her in that paper, and she does not appear in the author blocks of the team's other papers I checked (arXiv:2604.18976 STAR-Teaming, arXiv:2602.20170 CAGE), so no printed address exists to verify; a selectstar.ai/datumo pattern address would be a templated guess and was not used. Searched site:linkedin.com/in "Hyeji Choi" Datumo OR Selectstar AI - results returned only unrelated people (Seyeob Kim / 셀렉트스타, Song HyunYeun, Kazuaki Nimura, Hojin Cho, Gahyun Lee etc.); not a single profile carried both the name Hyeji Choi and a DATUMO/Selectstar or AI-safety anchor. Given how common Choi + Hyeji is in Korea, a bare name match would be a namesake, so rejected per the namesake rule. No ResearchGate profile surfaced with a DATUMO/Selectstar anchor. Name variants au:"Hye-ji Choi" and au:"HyeJi Choi" return only the same two papers. Searched again in Korean and English ('Hyeji Choi' Selectstar/DATUMO AI Safety Team red teaming; '최혜지' 셀렉트스타 AI 안전 연구원; site:linkedin.com/in Datumo 'AI Safety' researcher Seoul) - snippets surfaced only Selectstar corporate/press pages and unrelated Chois (Dasol Choi of AIM Intelligence/Yonsei, Jihye Choi), never a profile carrying both her name and a DATUMO/Selectstar anchor. Note the environment's egress proxy blocks linkedin.com, researchgate.net, scholar.google.com, openreview.net and aclanthology.org, so only search snippets could be read for those. A selectstar.ai pattern address remains a forbidden templated guess and was not constructed. All fields stay not_found.
